seed_schedule.first_20: Use the train, validation, and test seed lists in the base config.

representative_policy: Choose the dictionary size with the smallest reported 100-repetition mean held-out force error, then display global repetition 0 at that size without seed selection.
selection_policy: For every dictionary and repetition, select among 60 logarithmic penalties by minimum independent-validation weak residual over converged candidates. Do not consult truth or test trajectories and do not standardize, threshold, or refit.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged candidate, boundary selection, divergent rollout, and missing metric.
purpose: Source-independent replacement for the historical staged import chain; computes all ten dictionary sizes and all 100 repetitions from trajectories generated in this run.
